facts.fact: Elara 告诉 Aiden 她刚签完买下 inn 的合同，准备重开。
facts.anchor: I just signed the final contracts to buy the inn.

facts.fact: Elara 想在本周末办樱花赏花会做软重启，向 Aiden 讨主意。
facts.anchor: I was thinking some sort of cherry blossom appreciation party – music, drinks

facts.fact: 散步回来，他们的桌子被 Mia、Aiden、Sylvie 与 Lily-Ann 占下。
facts.anchor: Their table had been taken over by Mia, Aiden and Sylvie

facts.fact: Katie 揭短：六岁的 Jamie 为向月亮道歉翻进教堂、爬上塔顶睡着。
facts.anchor: He broke into the church – because he didn’t think the vicar would mind

facts.fact: Aiden 尝出 samosa 用芫荽茎、carom seed 与 amchoor，Sylvie 承认。
facts.anchor: The coriander was the stems, not the leaves. And you used carom seed.

facts.fact: Jamie 让她把东西留在他家，并给她清出衣柜与抽屉。
facts.anchor: I think, next time, you should leave the overnight bag at yours

facts.fact: Aiden 说已问过在 inn 办婚礼，被 Elara 以翻修工程量太大回绝。
facts.anchor: There’s too much work needed to bring the place back up to code.

facts.fact: Jamie 说 inn 空置时像蒙着裹尸布沉睡，现在正醒来。
facts.anchor: it was like it was asleep under a shroud
